size_basis: L x W x H mm, AQS-LITH-001 rev C frame 6061

machine.type: contact aligner per the node design block and AQS-LITH-001 rev C (named on the node): 6061 frame and base, aluminium stage plate, 4140 leadscrew 10 mm at 1 mm pitch (shop-cut on the lathe), chrome-on-glass mask with the 100 um pattern (cut on the mill), and the 365 nm LED array envelope (1 W optical) above the mask; 200 mJ/cm2 dose over the 100 mm field
machine.duty_line: duty section 2 prose carries the seed figure 500 x 500 x 800; the node 1200 x 600 x 800 governs (hold, WORK_ORDER W12, WS_SOLV precedent)

parts.stage: aluminium (AQS-LITH-001 section 3; plate size is the layout choice around the 100 mm field, W12)
parts.leadscrew: 4140, 10 mm dia, 1 mm pitch, cut on the lathe (AQS-LITH-001 section 2; make)
parts.mask: chrome on glass, 100 um pattern, cut on the mill (AQS-LITH-001 section 2; the pattern coating is not a solid)
parts.led_head: 365 nm LED array, 1 W optical (node design source) - purchased envelope per plan rule 6

machine.guard: four-post guard frame (6061, 40 x 40 posts + top rails) on the base plate pins the registry box (X-PAR-04); anchors in fasteners.csv
machine.material_rule: frame 6061 per AQS-LITH-001 section 3; duty section 3 (316L where the stream is wet) has nothing to match: mass in and out are zero, the machine is dry

N3.note: power terminal row - a cable schedule row: carried verbatim, never drawn
